machine: Windows 11, AMD64 Family 25 Model 97 (16 logical CPUs), Python 3.11.12
scope: CPU work of one strategy-monitor cycle: per symbol, resampling and the gap-pullback v1/v2, 5m Stoch RSI and Stoch trend-capture evaluators on a synthetic gapper session (04:00 pre-market plus the regular session up to the measured minute). Database reads, provider calls and event writes are not included.
findings: 200 symbols at the close: p95 1.46 s, about 5% of the 30 s monitor interval.
Cost grows with session length because each cycle re-evaluates the whole session (0.23 s after the first hour, 1.44 s at the close, for 200 symbols).

The first run after the session-close change measured 5.4 s at 200 symbols: regular_close_time recomputed the year's holidays for every bar. early_close_time now answers immediately for dates that cannot be early closes; the result matches the pre-change baseline (1.37 s) within 7%.
